map.综合分 = 资质完备度×40 + 法规符合度×35 + 检查通过率×25（各率均: Composite = qualification completeness×40 + regulatory conformity×35 + inspection pass rate×25 (each rate 0-1), rounded to an integer; grades are excellent (>=90) / good (>=75) / average (>=60) / fail.
map.综合分怎么算？: How is the composite score computed?
map.资质证照（营业执照、动物防疫条件合格证等）是经营前置硬条件，工具把资质权重设 4: Qualification certificates (business licence, animal quarantine compliance certificate and so on) are hard prerequisites for operating; the tool weights qualification at 40% with a hard 85% threshold, so failing it means an outright fail, avoiding the illusion of "high score but unlicensed" compliance.
map.连锁门店做巡店自检，用统一权重（资质40%/法规35%/检查25%）横向对比各店: Chain stores run a store self-inspection with unified weights (qualification 40% / regulation 35% / inspection 25%) to compare compliance across stores horizontally.
map.：资质齐备（完备度 100%→40 分）、法规符合 80%（→28 分）、日常检: : qualifications complete (completeness 100% -> 40 points), regulatory conformity 80% (->28), daily inspection 70% (->17.5): composite = 40+28+17.5 = 85.5 -> 86 points, judged "compliant and good". If qualification completeness falls below 85%, no matter how high the total it is judged "fail (qualification missing)".
